summary: Anteris Technologies Global Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $250 million of common stock via TD Cowen. Shares trade on Nasdaq (AVR) and ASX. Price is market-based; last sale $9.00. TD Cowen receives 3% gross commission. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity beyond standard ATM mechanics. Watch for dilution; no risk-arb angle.
